title: Panzer's Hepp-bound conjecture and the Panzer-Yeats Martin conjecture for phi^4 periods are incompatible
description:
Three pairs of completed primitive 13-loop φ4 graphs with exactly equal Hepp bounds and different Martin sequences. Hence Panzer's Conjecture 1.2 (equal Hepp bound iff equal period, arXiv:1908.09820) and Panzer–Yeats Conjecture 1.10 (equal Martin sequence iff equal period, arXiv:2304.05299) cannot both hold. Numerical periods of one pair, equal to 7·10-5 with different Martin invariants, indicate that the Martin conjecture is the false one.

The archive contains independent verification code (exact Hepp bounds modulo primes with a Chinese remainder bound, Martin invariants by spanning-tree partitions and by the vertex recursion), period logs, and a Lean 4 / Mathlib proof of the incompatibility in which the large finite computations are evaluated with native_decide.
